'''Control web''', known by some [[Witches of Dathomir]] as '''Crawler's Perch''' or '''Guiding Net''', was a [[Force power/Legends|Force power]] wielded by the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. The control web had to be initiated by several Nightsisters, in order to control the minds of creatures beneath the web.

==History==
In [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], several Nightsisters utilized this power while the [[Raining Leaves Clan]] and the [[Broken Columns Clan]] [[Conclave of the Raining Leaves Clan and the Broken Columns Clan|met]] in an attempt to [[Bright Sun Clan|unify]] the Clans. The Nightsisters were opposed to the all-[[Gender/Legends|male]] Broken Columns Clan joining with the Dathomiri Witches of the Raining Leaves Clan, so they used the control web to cause [[Sparkfly/Legends|sparkflies]] to attack the gathered Clans. Later they used a control web on 30 [[Rancor/Legends|rancors]] and had them attack, however, [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], who was present during the conclave, was able to trace strands of the web back to individual Nightsisters, whom he was then able to [[Death/Legends|kill]].

Some of the Nightsisters were captured by the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] and were forced to teach them this technique. It was later employed during the [[Mission to the Maw|fight against]] [[Abeloth]] by them. Luke noted that although it was rougher than when the Nightsisters used it, the sheer numbers of the Sith made it efficient in weakening Abeloth.
